_comment: Candidate adapters for the assistants we want to cover.
All of these use the generic-chat strategy, which decides from the request body shape
rather than a known URL — that is what lets us add a site without reverse-engineering
HONEST STATUS: generic-chat covers OpenAI-compatible chats, which is most of them.
It will NOT work on assistants that encode the conversation in a custom format.
Known problem cases are flagged below and need a dedicated strategy.

adapters._warning: Likely WILL NOT work. Gemini sends its conversation as a nested array inside Google's batchexecute RPC, not JSON with a messages field. Needs a dedicated strategy.
